title: Quebec City from the River
includes: Round-trip ferry ticket between Québec City and Lévis
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Treat yourself to a unique perspective on beautiful Québec City with a refined experience that combines history with exceptional panoramic views. After an introduction to the timeless charm of the Petit-Champlain district, get aboard the ferry across the majestic St. Lawrence River. On the opposite shore, a spectacular viewpoint awaits, offering the perfect setting to capture the city in all its splendor. As you glide along the water, a selection of stories from Québec’s maritime history enriches this inspiring and unforgettable getaway.
